title: antarctic-ice-shelf-utac — P120: real Antarctic ice shelf mass loss, mechanism, and regional asymmetry
description: Real Antarctic ice shelf mass budget (71 of 162 shelves lost mass 1997-2021, 8.3 trillion tonnes total, DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adi0186), a real Holocene meltwater-release feedback mechanism (Nature Geoscience 2025), and a real sign-flipped regional asymmetry under CMIP6 projections -- East Antarctica's feedback amplifies warming, West Antarctica's Amundsen/Bellingshausen sectors show cooling/suppressed warming (Muilwijk et al. 2026, The Cryosphere, DOI 10.5194/tc-20-1087-2026). v2.0.0 adds six more independently verified mechanisms: subglacial hydrology (85 newly detected active lakes, Wilson et al. 2025), the Southern Annular Mode -- where the Arctic "vortex instability exports cold air" analogy does NOT transfer (Lim et al. 2019, Verfaillie et al. 2022), sea-ice albedo feedback (Riihelä et al. 2021), seismic-ice interactions (Wiens et al. 2008), black carbon deposition (Cordero et al. 2022, Magalhães et al. 2024 -- distinct geography from P105's Tibetan Plateau focus), and ENSO teleconnection (Paolo et al. 2018, Ayabilah et al. 2026). Deliberately no UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge and no invented Gamma value -- see DISCLAIMER.md. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P120, domain: climate / cryosphere).
